data.name: Mobile & Frontend
content: {{Flutter}} is my daily driver. I've shipped production apps to the {{App Store and Play Store}} and run a monorepo of {{5 production apps}}.
On the web I build with {{React}} and {{Next.js}}, and lately {{Jaspr}} for server-rendered Dart.
I care about {{reusable UI systems}}: Cairn UI is a 65-component Flutter library with an engineered token system, published on {{pub.dev}}.

data.name: Backend
content: I build APIs in {{Go}}, {{FastAPI}}, {{Node.js / Express}} and {{Laravel}}.
My starter kits show how I like backends shaped: {{hexagonal layering}}, constructor injection, typed clients generated from {{OpenAPI}}, idempotency keys and graceful shutdown.

data.name: System Design & Architecture
content: {{Clean Architecture}} everywhere, with boundaries enforced by tests rather than good intentions.
I enjoy the hard cases: {{offline-first}} sync with outboxes and per-entity conflict resolution, streaming agent events, and trust boundaries around LLM output.

data.name: Database & Data
content: {{PostgreSQL}} is my default, with {{sqlc}} or {{SQLAlchemy 2.0 async}} and real migrations.
Also {{MongoDB}}, {{MySQL}}, {{SQLite}} and on-device stores like {{Drift}} and {{Hive}}, plus {{Chroma}} for vector search.

data.name: Security & Auth
content: {{JWT}} access tokens with refresh rotation and {{reuse detection}}, {{OAuth2}} sign-in, and {{role-based access control}}.
Also IAM policies and {{UI-level data masking}} for sensitive data.

data.name: Cloud & DevOps
content: Mobile release automation with {{GitHub Actions + Fastlane}}: build, sign, test, ship, cutting manual release effort by {{80%}}.
{{Firebase}} Analytics, FCM and Remote Config for staged rollouts, and {{Sentry}} for error tracking.

data.name: AI Engineering
content: I build on {{Claude}}: the API, the Agent SDK and headless Claude Code.

That includes {{RAG}} pipelines with cited answers, seventeen {{MCP servers}} behind a gateway, a live {{multi-agent dashboard}}, {{generative UI}} compiled into native Flutter widgets, and fully local models via {{Ollama}}.

data.name: Testing & Quality
content: Unit, widget, {{golden}} and integration tests on mobile, plus {{pytest}} and {{Vitest}} on the web and backend.
CI on every repo: strict type checking, lint, tests and build smoke tests.

data.name: Tools
content: {{Git}} and {{GitHub}} for everything, {{Neovim}} motions in my fingers (try them here), {{Figma}} for design hand-off, and {{Bash}} glue.
